blocks.text: 我确实说过我们会定期发布我们的模型……隆重推出 Gemini 4 Carbon，我们的下一代前沿模型。

inlines.text: 我确实说过我们会定期发布我们的模型……隆重推出 Gemini 4 Carbon，我们的下一代前沿模型。

blocks.text: 继两周前 Argon 发布之后，Carbon 展现了我们推进前沿的速度，它在最近更新的 @ArtificialAnlys 智能指数 v5.0 中排名第一，得分为 59。它还在关键网络安全评估中领先，在用于发现漏洞的 SEC-bench Pro 上得分 88.2%，在用于漏洞利用的 ExploitGym 上得分 54.8%，在用于修补的 CWE-bench 上得分 71.0%。

blocks.text: 即使与 Argon 相比，我们也在长周期任务上看到了显著改进，并且我们加强了前沿安全保障。

inlines.text: 即使与 Argon 相比，我们也在长周期任务上看到了显著改进，并且我们加强了前沿安全保障。

blocks.text: 正如我们对 Argon 所做的那样，我们将逐步且负责任地推出它。一些受信任的网络防御者将从本周开始获得访问权限。我们将通过我们的 Fairwind Program 将其扩展到更多合作伙伴，随后很快会更广泛地提供，所以请耐心等待！

blocks.text: I did say we'd be releasing our models periodically...introducing Gemini 4 Carbon, our next frontier model.

inlines.text: I did say we'd be releasing our models periodically...introducing Gemini 4 Carbon, our next frontier model.

blocks.text: Following Argon's release just two weeks ago, Carbon shows the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier, it ranks #1 on the recently updated v5.0 of @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index at 59. It also leads across key cybersecurity evaluations scoring 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for finding vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation, and 71.0% on CWE-bench for patching.

blocks.text: We’re seeing significant improvements in long-horizon tasks even compared to Argon, and we’ve strengthened frontier safeguards.

blocks.text: As we did with Argon, we’re going to roll it out gradually + responsibly. Some trusted cyber defenders will get access starting this week. We'll be expanding it to more partners through our Fairwind Program, ahead of wider availability soon, so hang tight!
